note: All four are real renders of this game's own code in headless Chrome (?shot=<mode>&seed=1), never edited or composited. The first by name is the cover.

shots.caption: Menu screen over the yard: SANDLINE YARD title, the dusk compound behind it.
First-person play up the middle lane: SABLE escorts ahead, the VIPER mid holder visible through the doors, a tracer crossing the lane, silos and the pipe gantry framing the gap.
Buy phase menu over the yard: guns, grenades, kevlar and helmet with prices and the round's money.
Match-end screen over the yard: final score SABLE 8 - 5 VIPER with kills, deaths, plants, defuses and headshots.
